title: Persist bounded Maker expiry preflight phase telemetry
author: agent:/root

scope.goal: Add bounded, queryable diagnostics that identify which exact receipt/admission, side-effect queue, handler, publication, or Paper-updater phase is holding an accepted exact ETH Reference Average Maker-GTD update when the existing expiry preflight deadline is reached, without changing any trading or lifecycle outcome.
inScope: Instrument only the exact closed-exception ETH neutral Reference Average Maker-GTD Paper expiry-preflight path and the shared market-data side-effect operations needed to describe its current in-memory blocker.

At an existing receipt_admission_timeout or side_effect_drain_timeout, capture one bounded point-in-time diagnostic snapshot and persist it inside that run's existing skip_diagnostics_json preflight_deadline object.
Capture handoff state as scalar summaries: active market-data receipt count, oldest active receipt start and age when present, expiry-admission-active state, and pending expiry-admission count.

Capture side-effect state as scalar summaries: matching outstanding, in-flight, and pending update counts; oldest matching receipt/enqueue timestamps and ages when present; total pending updates and tracked assets; update-worker task state; and at most one current global in-flight item with component, event type, asset/condition identifiers, receipt/enqueue/processing/phase timestamps, queue/processing/phase ages, and current bounded phase name.

Track bounded current phases across the existing handler and Paper updater, including resolved-event recording, trade-tick recording, optional persistence, publication wait, serialization-lock wait, exposure load, market-resolution settlement, Maker update evaluation/persistence, ordinary Paper update work, and position-mark work.

Use thread-safe, non-blocking in-memory snapshots, no raw payload capture, no unbounded collections, and no additional database read or write beyond the existing atomic timeout terminalization that already persists skip_diagnostics_json.

Add focused deterministic tests for receipt-state snapshots, pending and in-flight matching queue snapshots, phase transitions, both timeout JSON shapes, bounded field content, successful-path non-interference, and existing exact Maker lifecycle behavior.

Build and test locally using marked D:\CodexTemp artifacts, independently review the verbatim requests, approved contract, complete diff, and verification, then merge/push the verified commits through codex/reference-average-available-windows for user deployment.
outOfScope: Changing Reference Average signals, windows, thresholds, selected outcome, order price, stake, entry timing, GTD/PostOnly/TouchNoDepth semantics, fill inference, expiry deadline, timeout classification, fee/PnL/settlement accounting, mandatory label, PaperOnly status, or Live behavior.

Changing market-data queue ordering, concurrency, coalescing, capacity, priority, cancellation, retry, WebSocket subscription/reconnect/stale behavior, lifecycle cadence, or any database repository query/mutation semantics.

Adding or changing a PostgreSQL table, column, index, migration, retention worker, configuration value, continuous telemetry stream, dashboard surface, external log sink, raw WebSocket payload persistence, or generalized observability framework.

Repairing the eventual blocker before the new production snapshot proves its exact phase; settlement, database locking, publication, and other currently plausible causes remain unmodified and unclaimed.

Deploying, restarting, reconfiguring, or mutating production, rewriting existing timeout rows, or placing/canceling any venue or Live order. Production verification begins only after the user deploys the merged revision.
scope.periodOrFilter: Exact 28 ETH neutral Reference Average Maker-GTD Paper strategies and their maker_gtd_paper_v1/v2 timeout terminalizations. Read-only production evidence through 2026-08-21T11:32:25.065926Z found three natural cohorts with 18/18 nonfills reaching the existing deadline; one accepted event had a 223.239-223.526 second receipt-to-Maker-processing delay, but current persistence cannot split that interval by queue/handler/updater phase.
scope.firstVerification: Trace every timestamp and wait before PaperTradingMarketDataUpdater records processed_at_utc, enumerate the existing queue/handoff locks and test doubles, and prove the snapshot can be obtained under existing locks without waiting, changing scheduling, or adding database work.

requirements.text: Every exact Maker expiry-preflight timeout must persist a bounded handoff and side-effect snapshot that distinguishes an active receipt/admission obstruction from a matching pending or in-flight accepted update.
acceptanceCriteria: For receipt_admission_timeout and side_effect_drain_timeout, skip_diagnostics_json.preflight_deadline retains its existing phase, deadline_utc, and stale_after_seconds fields and adds one versioned diagnostic snapshot captured at terminal evaluation.

The handoff portion contains only scalar state: active receipt count, optional oldest receipt start/age, expiry admission active, and pending expiry-admission count; it never serializes receipt IDs or an unbounded list.

The exact-order queue portion reports matching outstanding, matching in-flight, and matching pending counts plus optional oldest matching receipt/enqueue timestamps and ages, using the same paper order, asset, condition, accepted-after, and expires-before predicates as the expiry drain.

The global queue portion reports total pending updates, tracked assets, update-worker state, and at most one in-flight item; it contains no raw payload, order book, token list, eligible-order list, or other unbounded content.

Snapshot methods are synchronous/non-blocking apart from their existing short in-memory locks, perform no database/network operation, do not wait for work completion, and cannot change queue/admission state.
If a dependency is the existing no-op implementation or no current item exists, diagnostics persist explicit zero/null/NotAvailable values without changing the timeout result.

requirements.text: The diagnostic snapshot must identify the currently executing handler or Paper-updater phase and its age well enough to select a later narrow correction from production evidence rather than inference.
acceptanceCriteria: Each queued update owns a thread-safe bounded execution trace initialized on enqueue and updated at existing phase boundaries without changing their order or exception/cancellation behavior.

The trace distinguishes queue wait from RecordResolvedEvent, RecordTradeTick, optional order-book/event persistence, ApplyPaperTradingUpdate, WaitForPublication, WaitForSerializationLock, LoadExposureSnapshot, SettleMarketResolution, ApplyMakerGtdPaperUpdate, ordinary fill processing, and UpdatePositionMarks whenever the corresponding phase is active.

The in-flight snapshot includes enqueued, received, processing-started, phase-entered, and captured-at timestamps when available, with non-negative queue, processing, and phase ages computed from the same capture time.
Phase names and snapshot schema are stable constants covered by exact assertions; unknown/no-op state is explicit rather than inferred from a missing JSON object.

Phase reporting is observational only: it cannot acquire the Paper updater serialization semaphore, alter cancellation tokens, catch/suppress an exception, change eligible order IDs, or affect persistence and atomic mutation paths.
A successful accepted pre-expiry fill and an ordinary non-timeout expiry keep their existing evidence and do not gain a timeout diagnostic snapshot.
